layouts.description: Draft configuration: The lake circuit follows the complete independently named Avenida Circuito del Lago, including its southern bends and the bridge section. Argentina tourism identifies this public-road circuit and access avenue; government documentation describes the 6.270 km historical course. The actual pinned road loop is 6172.4 m and remains unadjusted. Race-day barriers, chicane alignment and travel direction remain provisional; unrelated residential and service-road detours are excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 6172.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
